/**
 * @name XXE (XML External Entity) vulnerability in lxml
 * @description XML parsing with external entity expansion enabled can lead to file disclosure or SSRF
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-lxml
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module XXEConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    // lxml parsing functions that could be vulnerable to XXE
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember("parse").getACall()
      and sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
    or
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember("fromstring").getACall()
      and sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
    or
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember("XMLParser").getACall()
      and sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module XXEFlow = TaintTracking::Global<XXEConfig>;
import XXEFlow::PathGraph

from XXEFlow::PathNode source, XXEFlow::PathNode sink
where XXEFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential XXE vulnerability from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability where user-controlled input flows into lxml XML parsing functions
